bpmn:process.name: Subscription Delivery Deferment
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md BPMN-06; Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS FR-SUB-06-14,18 and FR-CAP-17. Reliability controls: NFR-REL-03,05-06. Website reference: index.html and linked app/subscriptions.js and app/subscription-state.js. SRS governs: second candidate is always one week after the final scheduled fulfillment, rather than the prototype's conditional next-week fallback. Read top to bottom in vertical Customer and Kitchen406 System swimlanes within one descriptive workflow pool. Customer interaction is modeled with user tasks. No manual owner approval. Reuse boundary: the Dates and Recheck business-rule tasks reference BPMN-09 capacity-validation rules without invoking its complete checkout process. Deferment-specific decisions and capacity replacement remain local. Authentication is an upstream precondition covered by BPMN-26; rule configuration is maintained separately by BPMN-34, not invoked during this request. Use call activities only when an entire separately defined reusable process is actually invoked. Diagram is descriptive BPMN 2.0, not executable code.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Deferment requested
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: Authenticated customer opens an owned subscription and identifies the affected fulfillment. Authentication is a precondition.

bpmn:userTask.name: Select upcoming delivery to defer
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-SUB-06. UI reference: My subscriptions > Subscription details > Defer This Week's Order.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Validate fulfillment, allowance and request timing
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-SUB-06,09,12. Validate ownership, upcoming and unfulfilled status, unused one-per-subscription allowance, and current time strictly before the configured preparation day begins.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Check two dates using BPMN-09 capacity rules
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: Reuse reference: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md BPMN-09, applicable capacity-validation rules only (FR-CAP-17 and applicable capacity-pool/blocked-date constraints). Inputs: subscription product, quantity, current allocations and exactly two candidate dates. Candidates remain owned by BPMN-06: affected fulfillment date + 1 day and final scheduled fulfillment date + 7 days (FR-SUB-13-14). Output: eligible subset with sufficient capacity; lookup failure cannot authorize a date. Do not expand shared capacity-rule branches here, search later dates, create a pending purchase, reserve checkout ingredients or start a payment hold. This is a business-rule reference, not a call of the entire BPMN-09 process.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Any eligible date?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: A failed availability lookup does not establish sufficient capacity and cannot authorize a change.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Display eligible dates and original schedule
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Offer only eligible candidates and explain the single-use allowance. No capacity is moved and no allowance is consumed when dates are displayed.

bpmn:userTask.name: Choose offered date and confirm, or keep schedule
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: Review original and replacement dates. Customer confirmation is required; no Admin/Owner approval.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Customer confirms?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Leaving or cancelling retains the original schedule and unused allowance.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Recheck eligibility and BPMN-09 capacity rules
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-SUB-09-14; FR-CAP-17. Re-read the subscription and fulfillment; verify ownership, upcoming/unfulfilled status, unused allowance and timing before preparation day begins. Ensure the chosen date remains a permitted candidate and matches the offered date. Reuse the same applicable BPMN-09 capacity rules as the initial date check, using current capacity and allocations. Output: valid/available or rejection reason. No new purchase, ingredient checkout reservation or payment hold. Keep this revalidation at confirmation to protect against concurrent changes.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Still valid and available?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Proceed only if every check passes.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Apply replacement and preserve deferment history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-SUB-07-11,18. Automatically commit one replacement: reserve replacement capacity and release the superseded active allocation consistently while retaining original/replacement allocation IDs and history; update affected fulfillment and its preparation schedule; record old/new dates and consume the allowance once. Preserve all four fulfillments, other fulfillment dates, quantities and prepaid product amounts. Use an atomic version-checked update; failed writes restore prior state and repeated confirmation must not apply twice (NFR-REL-03,05-06).

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Commit successful?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Success means all related changes were saved consistently.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Show updated schedule and deferment history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Display confirmed replacement; allowance now used. No new payment or product-amount recalculation.

bpmn:endEvent.name: One replacement committed
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Deferment process ends; production and fulfillment remain separate subprocesses.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Show reason; retain original schedule and allowance
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-SUB-09,11. Rejection, no eligible date, cancellation, stale availability or save failure causes no change from this attempt. Preserve any independently committed concurrent changes; do not restore stale state. Explain the outcome; the customer may start a fresh request if still eligible.

bpmn:endEvent.name: No replacement committed by this request
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Original schedule and unused allowance remain when no deferment has been committed.
